notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Local Delete Object Instance service in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The transition removes the invoking federate's known-instance state, leaves the federation-wide object and other federates' knowledge intact, and permits a later eligible rediscovery. It rejects a federate that owns instance attributes or has a pending ownership acquisition. Its focused production-filesystem regression also records the accepted one-argument service only after that local-forget transition; rejected calls append nothing. It does not claim timestamped/local-delete interactions, save/restore, resign-action disposition, DDM, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, or conformance. The contract uses immutable candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab.
